text:
The country famous for the Great Barrier Reef is Australia.

Regarding the text provided: "Each of the workers received their paycheck on Friday. It ensures that they have them before the weekend."

There is a pronoun-antecedent agreement error in the second sentence. The pronoun "It" does not agree with the plural antecedent "paycheck" (if referring to the paycheck itself) or the plural subject "workers." Additionally, "them" is used incorrectly to refer to the paycheck.

Corrected text:
"Each of the workers received their paycheck on Friday. This ensures that they have it before the weekend."

Alternatively, to maintain singular antecedent-pronoun agreement (though "their" is widely accepted as singular they in modern usage):
"Each of the workers received his or her paycheck on Friday. This ensures that he or she has it before the weekend."

However, the most natural correction using singular "they" is:
"Each of the workers received their paycheck on Friday. This ensures that they have it before the weekend."
